fig1_dipole_vector_potential.svg: Vector potential A of a magnetic dipole m along z, in the equatorial plane z=0. A = (mu0/4pi) m x rhat / r^2 circulates azimuthally around the dipole; colour (log scale) shows |A| falling as 1/s^2 with distance.
fig2_dipole_B_curl_A.svg: The magnetic field B = curl A of the same dipole, in the meridional plane y=0, obtained from the module's finite-difference curl of the vector potential. It is the familiar dipole field-line pattern, looping from the north to the south pole.
